AI Collaboration Style

Your AI Persona

Nine scenario-based questions. Three dimensions of cognitive integration. Eight distinct profiles — each one a genuine posture toward AI in your PMM practice, not a point on a scale.

There are no right answers. Each profile reflects a different way of integrating AI into your work. The interesting part isn't where you land — it's understanding why you're there and what it means for how you work.

The three dimensions this assessment measures:

Dimension 1
Cognitive Permeability
Does AI enter your actual reasoning, or stay in execution?
Dimension 2
Identity Coupling
Has your professional identity reorganized around AI?
Dimension 3
Symbolic Plasticity
Has AI changed what "good PMM work" means to you?
Based on Helen Edwards' Cognitive Sovereignty research at the Artificiality Institute — analysis of 1,250 transcripts studying how professionals integrate AI into their cognitive work. Adapted for the product marketing function.
